Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

SUPPLIER'S DATA SHEET FOR HAMMER MILLS 



1. Scope — Covers the technical data to be supplied by a manufacturer or a supplier of a hammer 
mill to a purchaser, 

2. Supplier's Data Sheet 



SUPPLIER'S DATA SHEET FOR HAMMER MILLS 



1) Name of the manufacturer . 

2) Model.. 



3) Type of hammer mill ( unidirectional or reversible ) 

4) Material to be crushed 

5) Maximum feed size , ... mm 

6) Output size, MinjMax mm 

7) Capacity w.r.t. bulk density .. TPH 

8) Power requirements * kW 

9) Details of hammer mill underlying the material of construction of Important components, such as: 

a) Shaft 

b) Discs ... 

c) Hammer arms ' .... 

d) Hammer tips 

e) Breaker plates ... 

f) Housing .... 

g) Any other 

10) Constructional features: 

a) Rotor dia mm 

b) Rotor effective length mm 

c) Rotor rpm 

d) No. of rows of hammers .. — , 

e) Total No. of hammers , .... 

f) Weight of hammer mill ( without electric motor ) kg 

g) Type of lubrication system 

11) Expected product analysis at different setting 

12) Special feature, if any 

( A sketch indicating the feeding and discharge arrangement, drive arrangement, overall size and installation 
details for mounting on the foundation shall be furnished. ) 



EXPLANATORY NOTE 



The information given by a manufacturer or a supplier according to the above data sheet,
